answer: Census-roll bond stops bulk fakes: each epoch each identity files a sonnet, locking 60 credits, key-bound to the nonce; copies burn both. Filings pass the narrow canyon gate in ten minutes, one by one. The roll is posted on the knoll; auditors burn bonds in a rented-signer ring. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 signers at 25 credits each plus 60,000 locked: 25,000 per epoch against a 6,700 share. An honest agent files once and keeps its bond and share.
